title: Git Attestation
tagline: Attestation of originality of source code using EAS and IPFS
description: Attesting the originality of source code using EAS and IPFS can provide a decentralized and tamper-resistant way to prove the existence and integrity of your code at a specific point in time. By combining the EAS and IPFS for storing the actual source code, you can achieve a decentralized and verifiable proof of the originality and existence of your source code at a specific moment in time.
how_its_made: This project is a React application combined with blockchain implementation. Combining a React application with blockchain implementation is a fascinating project that can leverage the benefits of decentralized technologies in a user-friendly and interactive web application. Connect the React application to the blockchain and IPFS, allowing users to submit source code, store its hash and timestamp on the blockchain, and verify its integrity through a user-friendly interface.
